manager.clineSetupHint: Install npm install -g cline@3.0.67, then run cline auth for Cline/ClinePass/ChatGPT login, or supply CLINE_PROVIDER, CLINE_MODEL and CLINE_API_KEY locally. Use --config or CLINE_DIR for separate ACP state; --data-dir is unsupported in ACP. Hosted auto-update is disabled. Removing this configuration preserves your system installation and Cline data. Cline 3.0.67 ACP does not forward images or session MCP servers; native MCP uses cline mcp.
manager.clineEnvVarHint: Saved OAuth login, or CLINE_API_KEY with CLINE_PROVIDER and CLINE_MODEL. Optional CLINE_DIR selects state. Pinning CLINE_PROVIDER disables provider switching.
manager.gooseSetupHint: Install Goose with `brew install block-goose-cli` on macOS, or the official CLI installer on Linux. Run `goose configure` to choose a provider and model, or set GOOSE_PROVIDER, GOOSE_MODEL, and the provider API key in the agent environment. Cognia launches `goose acp --with-builtin developer`; approval stays in Cognia. Update with `brew upgrade block-goose-cli` for Homebrew installs, or `goose update` for script installs. Removing a saved agent keeps your system installation and Goose sessions.
manager.gooseEnvVarHint: Use your existing Goose configuration, or GOOSE_PROVIDER, GOOSE_MODEL, and your provider API key. For DeepSeek use the OpenAI-compatible provider: GOOSE_PROVIDER=openai, OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com/v1, and your DeepSeek key as OPENAI_API_KEY.

manager.devinSetupHint: Install Devin CLI and run `devin auth login` once. Cognia launches `devin acp` and discovers models from the session; use `acp --model swe2` to select SWE-2 at launch. Choose Accept Edits (Code) when you want Devin to modify files. Cognia tools are available in each conversation alongside Devin’s native tools.
manager.aiderSetupHint: Install with uv tool install --force --python python3.12 --with pip aider-chat==0.86.2. Set --model and the provider API key here. Cognia isolates native .aider.conf.yml, dotenv and OAuth key discovery, and owns per-session history. Only sandboxed automatic confirmations and read-only Plan are supported. Update with the same uv command; deleting an agent keeps the system installation.
manager.aiderEnvVarHint: DeepSeek example: args --model deepseek/deepseek-flash and environment variable DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. Use your provider’s Aider model ID and key for other services.
manager.qoderSetupHint: Install with curl -fsSL https://qoder.com/install | bash, then run qoder login or supply QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN here. Cognia launches native ACP with explicit default permissions and per-session MCP. Background auto-update is disabled for this process; update separately with qoder update. Removing an agent keeps your system installation and Qoder data. Cognia supports local Qoder hosting on macOS and Linux.
manager.qoderEnvVarHint: Use an existing Qoder CLI login or QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN. QODER_CONFIG_DIR selects a separate configuration directory. A provider API key alone does not replace Qoder authentication; BYOK models depend on your account.
manager.kimiSetupHint: Install npm install -g @moonshot-ai/kimi-code@2.1.1 with Node.js 22.19 or newer, then run kimi login for your Kimi Code subscription. Cognia launches kimi acp and reuses the CLI login. KIMI_CODE_HOME selects separate state (default ~/.kimi-code). Update separately with kimi upgrade. Removing this configuration preserves the system installation and Kimi data. Use the current Node CLI, not the archived Python kimi-cli.
manager.kimiEnvVarHint: Subscription login needs no API key. Optional KIMI_CODE_HOME selects state. For a custom provider use KIMI_MODEL_NAME, KIMI_MODEL_PROVIDER_TYPE, KIMI_MODEL_BASE_URL and KIMI_MODEL_API_KEY; these replace subscription model selection.
